verdict.rationale: Warp documents a programmatic surface: an API, CLI and SDK, an Automation Platform triggered by APIs, and an OpenAPI spec reachable at docs.warp.dev/openapi.json. That makes this axis applicable, but nothing in the evidence shows API versioning or a published deprecation policy. The 'Legacy' label on the Generate feature is a product-feature designation, not an API deprecation policy, so it earns no credit.
